entries.title: Near enough to attend to
entries.literal_meaning: Cultivation where it can be regularly seen; dwellings close together.
entries.explanation: The accompanying adjective means something that can often be seen or attended to. The line pairs that accessibility in cultivation with proximity in living. Our reading asks what distance permits us to notice and care for; it does not prescribe settlement density or promise better harvests.
entries.meaning_odia: ପାଖରେ ଥିବା ବିଶେଷଣର ଅର୍ଥ—ଯାହାକୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଦେଖି ବା ତାହାର ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ ନେଇହେବ। ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଚାଷରେ ସେହି ସୁବିଧା ସହିତ ଲଗାଲଗି ରହିବାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଆମ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ, ଦୂରତା କେଉଁ କାମର ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ ନେବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ବା ବାଧା ଦିଏ। ଏହା ଘରବସତିର ନିୟମ ବା ଭଲ ଫସଲର ନିଶ୍ଚୟତା ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading connects proximity with the possibility of regular attention.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ପାଖରେ ଥିବାକୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର ତତ୍ତ୍ୱ ନେବାର ସୁବିଧା ସହ ଯୋଡ଼େ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠାଗାରର ମରାମତି ଖାତାଟି ଦୂର ଆଲମାରିରେ ରହୁଥିଲା। ସ୍ୱେଚ୍ଛାସେବୀମାନେ ତାହାକୁ କାମର ଟେବୁଲ ପାଖରେ ରଖିଲେ, ଯେପରି ରୋଜ ଦେଖିପାରିବେ। / Volunteers move a repair log near their worktable so they can check it daily. This practical analogy is invented.
entries.cultural_context: This is the adjective-sense example, separate from the earlier river/kinship saying and later named literary line. No agricultural trial or universal village pattern is established.

entries.title: You turned away from me
entries.literal_meaning: Newness lasts how many days? Seeing the new, you forgot the old and turned your back on me.
entries.explanation: The speaker protests being forgotten when something new appears. The source places the saying under neglect, but identifies neither the relationship nor the new attraction. Our reading attends to the person left out of another’s enthusiasm, without making every change a betrayal.
entries.meaning_odia: ନୂଆ କିଛି ଦେଖି ପୁରୁଣାକୁ ଭୁଲିଯିବାରେ ବକ୍ତା ନିଜ ପ୍ରତି ଅବହେଳାର କଥା କହୁଛନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନ ଏହାକୁ ଅନାସ୍ଥା ଅର୍ଥରେ ଦେଇଛି; ସମ୍ପର୍କଟି କଣ ବା ନୂଆ ଆକର୍ଷଣଟି କଣ, କହିନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କ ଉତ୍ସାହ ଭିତରେ ବାଦ୍ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ଲୋକର ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣାଯାଏ। ସବୁ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନକୁ ବିଶ୍ୱାସଘାତ କୁହାଯାଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: An unnamed speaker protests neglect after a new attraction appears.
entries.odia_summary: ନୂଆ ଆକର୍ଷଣ ଆସିବା ପରେ ଅବହେଳା ପାଇଥିବା ଜଣଙ୍କର ପ୍ରତିବାଦ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ନୂଆ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପରେ ସମସ୍ତେ ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ଥିଲେ। ପୁରୁଣା ଦଳର ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “ଆମ କାମର ଖବର ବି ନିଅ।” ସେମାନେ ଦୁଇ ଦଳର ଆଲୋଚନା ପାଇଁ ସମୟ ରଖିଲେ। / An established team asks not to be forgotten during a new project. The shared meeting is an invented continuation.
entries.cultural_context: The exact source does not identify lovers, spouses, friends or a historical occasion. The opening question and addressed protest are retained without supplying those roles.

entries.title: An unexpected claimant
entries.literal_meaning: Even when there is no rival, an unexpected claimant appears.
entries.explanation: The headword defines an unexpected rival, enemy or claimant to a share. The saying contrasts apparent absence with sudden arrival. Our application notices how a settled expectation can be interrupted; it does not prove that the newcomer’s claim is false or that every undertaking must meet opposition.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ହଠାତ୍ ଆସୁଥିବା ପ୍ରତିଦ୍ୱନ୍ଦ୍ୱୀ, ଶତ୍ରୁ ବା ଭାଗ ଦାବି କରୁଥିବା ଲୋକକୁ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। କେହି ନଥିବା କଥା ପାଖରେ ହଠାତ୍ କେହି ବାହାରିବା ରଖାଯାଇଛି। ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ ଧରିନିଆ କଥା କିପରି ବଦଳିପାରେ, ତାହା ଦିଶେ। ନୂଆ ଲୋକର ଦାବି ମିଛ ବା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ କାମରେ ବିରୋଧୀ ଆସିବେ ବୋଲି ଏହା ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading notices an unexpected challenge without judging its legitimacy.
entries.odia_summary: ଅପେକ୍ଷା ବାହାରର ଦାବିକୁ ଆମ ପାଠ ଦେଖେ; ତାହାର ଯଥାର୍ଥତା ଉପରେ ରାୟ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଘରଟି ଖାଲି ବୋଲି ଦଳ ଭାବିଥିଲା। ଅନ୍ୟ ଦଳ ଆସି ନିଜ ବୁକିଂ ଦେଖାଇଲା। ସେମାନେ ଖାତା ମିଳାଇ ଦେଖିଲେ। / Another group arrives with a booking for a room thought to be free; both check the register. The scene is invented, not a property dispute report.
entries.cultural_context: The supplied gloss governs the compound here; no journey, festival, property law or named dispute is reconstructed from its parts.

entries.title: A ring does not change the blow
entries.literal_meaning: A slap from a gold-ringed hand brings the benefit of bathing in the Ganga.
entries.explanation: The saying gives a blow from an adorned hand the value of a sacred bath. Our critical reading questions that elevation: an ornament does not make harm deserved or beneficial. This is our response to the line, not a supplied traditional counter-moral or a claim of ritual efficacy.
entries.meaning_odia: ସୁନାମୁଦି ପିନ୍ଧା ହାତର ଚାପୁଡ଼ାକୁ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଗଙ୍ଗାସ୍ନାନର ଫଳ ସହିତ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠ ସେହି ମୂଲ୍ୟଦାନକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ—ଅଳଙ୍କାର ଥିବାରୁ ଆଘାତ ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବା ଉପକାରୀ ହୋଇଯାଏନାହିଁ। ଏହା ଆମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା; ଉତ୍ସରେ ଦିଆଯାଇଥିବା ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ବିପରୀତ ଉପଦେଶ ବା ଧାର୍ମିକ ଫଳର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical response separates an adorned hand from any justification for its blow.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଅଳଙ୍କାରକୁ ଆଘାତର ଯଥାର୍ଥତାଠାରୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “ହାତରେ ଦାମୀ ଜିନିଷ ଥିଲେ ଆଘାତ ବଦଳିଯାଏ କି?” ଅନ୍ୟମାନେ ଅଳଙ୍କାର ଓ ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ଅଲଗା କରି ଆଲୋଚନା କଲେ। / Readers distinguish adornment from conduct. This discussion is invented; no assault is depicted or reported.
entries.cultural_context: The first duplicated headword block supplies this wording. A second repeats altered spellings; neither is silently repaired. The earlier Krishna Singh Mahabharata illustration is separate, not this saying’s authorship.
